recipes.title: Savory Dried Thyme, Mushroom & Spinach Soft Scramble
recipes.summary: Fluffy low-heat scrambled eggs folded with olive-oil browned mushrooms, wilted baby spinach, and fragrant pantry dried thyme.
steps: Saute sliced mushrooms in olive oil with dried thyme 4 minutes until tender and woodsy-fragrant.
Wilt baby spinach in the pan 30 seconds, lower heat, and pour in lightly beaten eggs.
Fold gently 2 to 3 minutes until soft moist curds set, then finish with cracked black pepper.
tips: Dried thyme blooms right in warm olive oil and brings effortless bistro flavor to everyday eggs.
Soft, tender, and high in morning protein.

recipes.title: French Bistro Dried Thyme & Garlic White Bean Toast
recipes.summary: Creamy cannellini beans warmed gently in extra-virgin olive oil, garlic, dried thyme, and lemon, spread thick on whole-grain toast.
steps: Warm olive oil over low heat and bloom minced garlic and dried thyme 45 seconds until aromatic.
Add rinsed cannellini beans and 3 tbsp water; simmer 4 minutes and mash half softly with a fork.
Stir in fresh lemon juice and spoon generously over warm whole-grain toast.
tips: Pantry dried thyme turns humble canned white beans into a cozy 10-minute breakfast.
Rich in gentle soluble fiber and plant protein.

recipes.title: Warm Dried Thyme, Sweet Potato & Parmesan Oats
recipes.summary: Comforting savory rolled oats simmered in vegetable broth with grated sweet potato, dried thyme, olive oil, and Parmesan.

ingredient_details.item: finely grated sweet potato or carrot

steps: Simmer rolled oats, grated sweet potato, dried thyme, and vegetable broth 7 minutes until tender and velvety.
Remove from heat and stir in extra-virgin olive oil and grated Parmesan.
Spoon into a warm bowl and serve right away.
tips: Finely grated sweet potato cooks completely soft in the exact same 7 minutes as rolled oats.
Top with a soft-cooked egg for extra staying power.

recipes.title: Warm Dried Thyme-Honey, Ricotta & Peach Toast
recipes.summary: Crisp whole-grain toast spread with cool creamy ricotta, juicy peach or pear slices, and a warm 1-minute dried thyme-steeped honey drizzle.

ingredient_details.note: steeped in warm honey and strained

steps: Warm honey with 1 tbsp water and dried thyme 30 seconds, steep 3 minutes, and strain through a fine tea strainer.
Spread warm whole-grain toast with creamy ricotta and arrange ripe peach slices on top.
Drizzle generously with the floral thyme honey.
tips: Greek wild thyme honey is legendary across the Mediterranean—steeping dried thyme into everyday honey recreates its floral warmth at home.
Straining removes the tiny leaves so the glaze stays silky.

recipes.title: Make-Ahead Dried Thyme, Zucchini & Potato Egg Frittata
recipes.summary: Tender oven-baked vegetable frittata pairing diced zucchini, baby potatoes, milk, eggs, and aromatic dried thyme into soft sliceable wedges.
steps: Heat oven to 350 F; saute diced zucchini and potatoes in olive oil with dried thyme 4 minutes until soft and fragrant.
Whisk eggs, milk, and a pinch of salt and pepper and pour evenly over the vegetables.
Bake 16 to 18 minutes until puffed and softly set, then rest 5 minutes before slicing.
tips: Four ready-to-eat high-protein breakfasts from one simple bake.
Soft custard-like texture cuts effortlessly with a fork.

recipes.title: Cozy Pantry Dried Thyme, Carrot & Green Lentil Soup
recipes.summary: Classic everyday French lentil soup simmered with sweet carrots, celery, onion, garlic, olive oil, and generous aromatic dried thyme.
steps: Saute onion, carrots, and celery in olive oil 5 minutes until softened, then stir in dried thyme 45 seconds until warmly fragrant.
Add cooked lentils and vegetable broth and simmer gently 14 minutes until rich and cozy.
Mash a cup of soup lightly against the pot for velvety body and ladle warm.
tips: Dried thyme is the backbone of classic French lentil soup and holds up beautifully during simmering.
Brighten with a splash of lemon juice or apple cider vinegar at serving.

recipes.title: Earthy Dried Thyme, Mushroom & Pearl Barley Soup
recipes.summary: Hearty, soothing mushroom and barley broth scented deeply with pantry dried thyme, garlic, onion, and olive oil.
steps: Saute sliced mushrooms and onion in olive oil 6 minutes until browned, then stir in garlic and dried thyme 1 minute.
Add quick-cooking pearl barley and vegetable broth and simmer gently 16 minutes until barley is plump and tender.
Ladle warm into bowls and finish with cracked black pepper.
tips: Quick-cooking pearl barley turns mushroom-thyme soup silky and sustaining in under 30 minutes.
Freezes smoothly for effortless rainy-day lunches.

recipes.title: Warm Lemon-Thyme Chickpea, Spinach & Quinoa Bowl
recipes.summary: Fast skillet-warmed chickpeas infused with olive oil, garlic, dried thyme, and lemon, served over fluffy quinoa and wilted baby spinach.
steps: Warm olive oil in a skillet over medium-low heat and infuse minced garlic and dried thyme 1 minute.
Stir in rinsed chickpeas and 2 tbsp water and warm 4 minutes so the beans absorb the herb oil.
Fold in cooked quinoa and baby spinach until wilted, remove from heat, and brighten with lemon juice.
tips: Warming dried thyme briefly in olive oil softens the leaves completely and triples their aroma.
Ready in 14 minutes from basic pantry staples.

recipes.title: Restorative Dried Thyme, Chicken & Soft Rice Soup
recipes.summary: Soothing homestyle chicken soup simmering carrots, celery, shredded poached chicken, soft cooked rice, and comforting dried thyme.
steps: Saute sliced carrots and celery in olive oil 4 minutes, then stir in dried thyme 30 seconds.
Pour in chicken broth and simmer 8 minutes until vegetables are fork-tender.
Fold in cooked rice and shredded poached chicken and warm 2 to 3 minutes before ladling into bowls.
tips: A classic calming broth soup that is hydrating, gluten-free, and effortless to eat.
Finish with a gentle squeeze of fresh lemon juice.

recipes.title: Steamed Beet, Spinach & Warm Thyme Vinaigrette Salad
recipes.summary: Tender diced beets, baby spinach, toasted walnuts, and goat cheese dressed in a fragrant warmed olive oil, cider vinegar, and dried thyme vinaigrette.
steps: Warm olive oil and dried thyme gently in a small pan 45 seconds until aromatic, remove from heat, and whisk in apple cider vinegar.
Arrange baby spinach and steamed diced beets in a salad bowl.
Drizzle with the warm thyme dressing and scatter walnuts and goat cheese over top.
tips: Warming dried thyme briefly in olive oil wakes it up far better than shaking it cold into dressing.
Ready in 10 minutes with grocery-steamed beets.

recipes.title: One-Pan Dried Thyme, Garlic & Lemon Roast Chicken
recipes.summary: Juicy sheet-pan chicken thighs, sweet carrots, and baby potatoes roasted in extra-virgin olive oil, garlic, lemon, and abundant pantry dried thyme.
steps: Heat oven to 400 F; toss chicken thighs, carrots, and halved baby potatoes with olive oil, garlic, and dried thyme on a parchment-lined sheet pan.
Roast 22 to 25 minutes until chicken reaches 165 F and vegetables are caramelized and fork-tender.
Squeeze fresh lemon juice across the hot pan and serve warm.
tips: Sunday roast-chicken aroma on a simple 35-minute weeknight sheet pan.
Parchment paper keeps cleanup effortless.

recipes.title: Baked Provençal Zucchini, Tomato, White Bean & Thyme Gratin
recipes.summary: Warm bubbling Mediterranean casserole baking zucchini, cherry tomatoes, cannellini beans, garlic, olive oil, and dried thyme until spoon-soft.
steps: Heat oven to 400 F; toss zucchini, cherry tomatoes, cannellini beans, sliced garlic, olive oil, and dried thyme right inside a baking dish.
Bake 20 minutes until tomatoes burst and zucchini is tender.
Scatter Parmesan across top and bake 4 minutes more until lightly golden; serve warm with crusty bread or polenta.
tips: Skip Parmesan for a 100% plant-based Mediterranean supper.
Juicy, soft, and packed with gentle fiber.

recipes.title: Baked Garlic, Lemon & Dried Thyme Salmon with Sweet Peas
recipes.summary: Moist baked salmon fillets rubbed with olive oil, garlic, lemon zest, and dried thyme, served alongside sweet green peas and soft mashed potatoes.

ingredient_details.item: fresh lemon juice plus 1 tsp zest

steps: Heat oven to 400 F; stir olive oil, grated garlic, lemon zest, and dried thyme into a quick rub.
Coat salmon fillets evenly and bake 12 to 14 minutes until fish flakes gently.
Finish with fresh lemon juice and serve warm alongside tender steamed green peas.
tips: Dried thyme and lemon zest create a fragrant herb crust in 60 seconds with zero chopping.
Rich in omega-3s and gentle on weeknights.

recipes.title: Cozy Dried Thyme Chicken & Mushroom Braise over Polenta
recipes.summary: Tender chicken pieces and golden mushrooms simmered in savory thyme-garlic broth and spooned generously over creamy quick-cooking polenta.
steps: Brown chicken chunks and sliced mushrooms in olive oil 6 minutes, then stir in minced garlic and dried thyme 1 minute.
Pour in chicken broth, cover, and simmer 10 minutes until chicken is tender (165 F) and juices taste deeply savory.
Spoon the fragrant chicken, mushrooms, and thyme gravy over bowls of soft warm polenta.
tips: Cutting chicken thighs into bite-size pieces before simmering speeds cooking and makes eating effortless with a spoon or fork.
Dairy-free comfort food.

recipes.title: Warm Dried Thyme Lentil & Mashed Sweet Potato Shepherd's Skillet
recipes.summary: Plant-based comfort classic simmering brown lentils, carrots, peas, and tomato with hearty dried thyme beneath a blanket of silky mashed sweet potato.
steps: Simmer diced carrots, lentils, tomato sauce, vegetable broth, and dried thyme in an oven-safe skillet 12 minutes until thickened; stir in sweet peas.
Spread warm velvety mashed sweet potato smoothly across the top of the lentil base.
Warm in a 375 F oven for 10 minutes until bubbling around the edges and scoop warm into bowls.
tips: Every layer is soft, savory, and spoonable—ideal for cozy family dinners and leftovers.
Naturally gluten-free and plant-based.

recipes.title: Wild Blueberry, Greek Yogurt & Brewed Thyme Smoothie
recipes.summary: Soothing botanical berry smoothie blending chilled freshly steeped dried thyme tea, frozen blueberries, Greek yogurt, banana, and honey.

ingredient_details.note: steeped in 1/2 cup hot water 5 minutes and strained

steps: Steep dried thyme in 1/2 cup hot water covered 5 minutes, strain through a fine tea sieve, and chill with 3 ice cubes.
Combine chilled thyme infusion, Greek yogurt, frozen blueberries, banana, and honey in a blender.
Blend 45 seconds until deep violet and velvety smooth.
tips: Brewing and straining dried thyme first captures its calming Mediterranean perfume with zero grainy leaf bits.
Blueberries and thyme-honey taste like a mountain meadow.

recipes.title: Golden Peach, Rolled Oat & Brewed Thyme Smoothie
recipes.summary: Creamy dairy-free breakfast smoothie pairing chilled steeped thyme tea, oat milk, frozen peaches, rolled oats, and a drop of honey.

ingredient_details.note: steeped in 1/3 cup hot water 5 minutes and strained

steps: Steep dried thyme in 1/3 cup hot water covered 5 minutes, strain cleanly, and cool with 2 ice cubes.
Blend chilled thyme tea, oat milk, rolled oats, frozen peaches, and honey 55 seconds until silky.
Pour into a glass and enjoy chilled.
tips: Peaches and thyme-infused honey are a beloved Provençal summer duo.
Naturally dairy-free and caffeine-free.

recipes.title: Sweet Pear, Almond Milk & Brewed Thyme Silk Smoothie
recipes.summary: Gentle orchard smoothie uniting ripe peeled pear, almond milk, chilled brewed dried thyme tea, vanilla, and lemon zest.

ingredient_details.note: steeped in 1/3 cup hot water 5 minutes and strained

steps: Steep dried thyme in 1/3 cup hot water covered 5 minutes, strain cleanly, and chill with 4 ice cubes.
Add chilled thyme infusion, ice, almond milk, diced pear, vanilla, and lemon zest to a blender.
Blend 50 seconds until smooth, airy, and delicately fragrant.
tips: Delicate, calming, and soothing on the throat.
Peeling the pear first creates a completely velvety glass.

recipes.title: Blackberry, Kefir & Brewed Thyme Antioxidant Smoothie
recipes.summary: Deep ruby probiotic smoothie blending plain kefir, chilled brewed thyme tea, frozen blackberries, banana, and maple syrup.

ingredient_details.note: steeped in 1/3 cup hot water 5 minutes and strained

steps: Steep dried thyme in 1/3 cup hot water covered 5 minutes, strain, and chill with 2 ice cubes.
Blend chilled thyme tea, plain kefir, frozen blackberries, banana, and maple syrup 50 seconds until silky.
Serve cold right away.
tips: Blackberries and thyme are a classic French country jam pairing—refreshing and creamy in smoothie form.
Frozen blueberries work smoothly for a seed-free swap.

recipes.title: Crisp Apple, Spinach & Brewed Thyme Green Smoothie
recipes.summary: Bright garden green smoothie uniting chilled brewed dried thyme tea, crisp diced apple, baby spinach, banana, and fresh lemon juice.

ingredient_details.note: steeped in 3/4 cup hot water 5 minutes and chilled

steps: Steep dried thyme in 3/4 cup hot water covered 5 minutes, strain cleanly, and chill over ice.
Blend chilled thyme tea and baby spinach 20 seconds until completely liquefied.
Add diced apple, frozen banana, and fresh lemon juice and blend 40 seconds until bright green and frosty.
tips: Lemon brightens brewed thyme and crisp apple into an uplifting midday green glass.
Dairy-free, nut-free, and caffeine-free.

recipes.title: Traditional Brewed Dried Thyme, Lemon & Honey Cooler
recipes.summary: Time-honored European herbal lemon-thyme drink steeping dried thyme leaves with honey and freshly squeezed lemon juice, served iced or warm.
steps: Steep dried thyme in 1 cup hot water covered 5 minutes, then strain through a fine tea sieve.
Stir honey into the warm thyme infusion until dissolved, then add freshly squeezed lemon juice.
Pour over a tall glass of ice—or sip gently warm whenever you want comfort.
tips: Traditional thyme-lemon-honey infusion has been prized across Europe for centuries for soothing clarity.
100% caffeine-free.

recipes.title: Orchard Pressed Apple Cider & Brewed Thyme Cooler
recipes.summary: Crisp unfiltered pressed apple cider infused cleanly with dried thyme and fresh ginger, brightened with lemon and served over ice.
steps: Warm apple cider gently with dried thyme and ginger slices 3 minutes without boiling, then cover and steep 3 minutes off heat.
Strain through a fine sieve and stir in fresh lemon juice.
Pour over tall glasses of ice (or enjoy warm in mugs).
tips: Apple and thyme are warm, natural orchard partners requiring zero added sweetener.
Straining through a fine tea sieve keeps the cider crystal clear.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Orange & Brewed Thyme Sparkling Tonic
recipes.summary: Uplifting citrus spritzer pairing freshly squeezed sweet orange juice, chilled steeped dried thyme tea, and sparkling water over ice.
steps: Steep dried thyme in 1/3 cup hot water covered 5 minutes, then strain cleanly.
Pour the fragrant thyme infusion and freshly squeezed orange juice over ice cubes.
Top with chilled sparkling water, stir lightly, and enjoy crisp.
tips: Sweet orange juice balances earthy thyme effortlessly without added syrup.
Swap sparkling water for still cold water if preferred.

recipes.title: Chilled Sweet Pear, Ginger & Brewed Thyme Press
recipes.summary: Gentle, mellow pure pear juice layered with chilled brewed dried thyme tea, a crisp drop of lemon, and fresh ginger juice.
steps: Steep dried thyme in 1/3 cup hot water covered 5 minutes and strain cleanly.
Pour strained thyme infusion, pure pear juice, ginger juice, and lemon juice over ice cubes.
Stir gently and serve chilled.
tips: Softly sweet pear and aromatic thyme feel calm and refreshing any afternoon.
Naturally caffeine-free.

recipes.title: Ruby Tart Cherry & Brewed Dried Thyme Evening Press
recipes.summary: Jewel-red non-alcoholic aperitif combining unsweetened tart cherry juice, freshly steeped thyme tea, a touch of honey, and sparkling water.
steps: Steep dried thyme in 1/3 cup hot water covered 5 minutes, strain cleanly, and dissolve honey while warm.
Pour thyme infusion and tart cherry juice over ice cubes.
Top with chilled sparkling water and stir lightly.
tips: Deep berry-ruby color and savory-sweet herbal warmth make a wonderful evening wind-down drink.
Rich in natural cherry polyphenols with zero caffeine.

recipes.title: Fresh Thyme, Roasted Red Grape, Orange & Olive Oil Ricotta
recipes.summary: Warm halved red grapes softly simmered with fresh thyme leaves, orange juice, and fruity olive oil over whipped whole-milk ricotta.

ingredient_details.item: fresh orange juice plus 1/2 tsp zest

steps: Warm olive oil with fresh thyme leaves 20 seconds, then simmer halved red grapes, orange juice, and a pinch of black pepper 5 minutes until juicy.
Fluff ricotta with orange zest into two morning bowls.
Spoon warm thyme-glazed grapes and pan juice across the ricotta.
tips: Tiny fresh thyme leaves soften effortlessly and require no chopping.
Mediterranean sweet-savory start.

recipes.title: Warm Thyme, Flaked Salmon, Celery & Pearl Barley Breakfast Bowl
recipes.summary: Nourishing savory morning grain bowl uniting cooked pearl barley, finely diced celery stalk, flaky poached salmon, fresh thyme, rosemary, and olive oil.
steps: Soften finely diced celery stalk, fresh thyme, and rosemary in olive oil 3 minutes.
Add cooked barley and warm broth, simmering 4 minutes until silky.
Fold in flaked poached salmon off the heat and serve warm.
tips: Gentle savory breakfast packed with omega-3s and soluble fiber.
Soft texture throughout.

recipes.title: Custard-Soft Eggs with Fresh Thyme, Sage, Chicken & Sunflower Oil
recipes.summary: Creamy stovetop scrambled eggs folded with finely shredded poached chicken, softened celery stalk, fresh thyme, minced sage, black pepper, and sunflower oil.
steps: Soften very finely diced celery stalk, fresh thyme, and minced sage in sunflower oil 3 minutes over gentle heat.
Pour in whisked eggs and black pepper, folding slowly until soft velvety curds form.
Fold in shredded poached chicken off the heat and serve warm.
tips: Garden herbs wake up gentle soft eggs without needing heavy salt.
Protein-rich and tender.

recipes.title: Warm Thyme-Infused Blueberry, Banana & Walnut Oil Morning Oats
recipes.summary: Soothing rolled oats gently cooked with mashed ripe banana, fresh thyme leaves, sweet blueberries, orange zest, and cold-pressed walnut oil.
steps: Simmer rolled oats, milk, mashed banana, and fresh thyme leaves 6 to 7 minutes until silky.
Fold in blueberries and orange zest off the heat.
Spoon into warm bowls and finish with cold-pressed walnut oil.
tips: Blueberries and fresh thyme are a classic French jam combination.
Naturally sweet with zero added sugar.

recipes.title: Thyme & Black Tea Poached Dark Cherries over Soft Cottage Cheese
recipes.summary: Tender dark cherries gently poached in mild black tea with fresh thyme leaves and a tiny pinch of clove, served over cottage cheese with flaxseed oil.
steps: Simmer halved dark cherries, brewed mild black tea, fresh thyme leaves, and a tiny pinch of clove 5 to 6 minutes until soft.
Spoon soft cottage cheese into two bowls and ladle warm fragrant cherries on top.
Drizzle gently with cold-pressed flaxseed oil.
tips: Poaching softens cherry skins while infusing warm tea-thyme aroma.
Use decaf black tea if preferred.

recipes.title: Classic Fresh Thyme, Chicken, Celery & Pearl Barley Soup
recipes.summary: Comforting homestyle soup simmering tender chicken, cooked pearl barley, finely diced celery stalk, generous fresh thyme, black pepper, and olive oil.
steps: Soften finely diced celery stalk and fresh thyme leaves in olive oil 4 minutes.
Add cooked barley, shredded chicken, black pepper, and chicken broth.
Simmer gently 12 minutes until celery is completely tender and serve warm.
tips: Generous fresh thyme gives classic chicken-barley soup warm restorative fragrance.
Gentle, hydrating, and easy to swallow.

recipes.title: Warm Thyme Olive Oil, Flaked Salmon, White Bean & Sumac Bowl
recipes.summary: Mediterranean midday bowl uniting tender white beans, thinly sliced celery stalk, flaky poached salmon, fresh thyme, ruby sumac, orange juice, and olive oil.
steps: Warm olive oil briefly with fresh thyme leaves 30 seconds to release aroma, then whisk with orange juice and sumac.
Toss soft white beans and thinly sliced celery stalk with the thyme-sumac dressing.
Top gently with flaky poached salmon and serve.
tips: Za'atar-inspired blend of thyme and sumac makes simple fish and beans sing.
Soft texture and omega-3 rich.

recipes.title: Fresh Thyme, Tarragon, Cantaloupe & Soft Chickpea Walnut Bowl
recipes.summary: Refreshing no-cook plant-forward salad tossing soft chickpeas, sweet cantaloupe, finely diced celery stalk, fresh thyme, tarragon, and cold-pressed walnut oil.
steps: Whisk cold-pressed walnut oil, fresh orange juice, fresh thyme leaves, and chopped tarragon.
Fold in soft chickpeas, finely diced celery stalk, and ripe cantaloupe cubes.
Let sit 5 minutes for flavors to meld, then serve.
tips: Delicate fresh thyme leaves bring garden warmth to sweet melon and chickpeas.
Zero stove work required.

recipes.title: Golden Fresh Thyme, Carrot, Celery, Turmeric & Ginger Puree
recipes.summary: Silky bright-gold soup simmering carrots and celery stalk with generous thyme, grated ginger, turmeric, black pepper, and sunflower oil.
steps: Soften sliced carrots, celery stalk, fresh thyme, and grated ginger in sunflower oil 4 minutes, then bloom turmeric and black pepper.
Add vegetable broth and simmer gently 14 minutes until completely fork-tender.
Blend silky smooth and serve warm.
tips: Thyme pairs naturally with sweet carrots and warming golden turmeric.
Completely smooth and easy to sip.

recipes.title: Warm Thyme, Pearl Barley, Red Grape, Raspberry & Pumpkin Oil Bowl
recipes.summary: Cozy fruit-and-grain lunch warming cooked pearl barley with halved red grapes, fresh thyme, black pepper, fresh raspberries, and roasted pumpkin seed oil.
steps: Warm halved red grapes, fresh thyme leaves, black pepper, and 2 tbsp water in a skillet 3 minutes until glossy.
Fold in warm cooked pearl barley for 2 minutes to absorb the fragrant juices.
Plate warm, scatter fresh raspberries, and drizzle generously with roasted pumpkin seed oil.
tips: Earthy pumpkin seed oil and bright thyme unite sweet orchard fruit and nutty barley.
Soft and quick.

recipes.title: Lemon-Free Thyme, Rosemary & Sweet Orange Baked Salmon
recipes.summary: Moist baked salmon fillets glazed with generous fresh thyme, minced rosemary, sweet orange juice and zest, black pepper, and extra-virgin olive oil.
steps: Whisk extra-virgin olive oil, fresh orange juice, fresh thyme, finely minced rosemary, and black pepper.
Place salmon fillets in a baking dish, spoon herb-orange oil over top, and bake at 375°F for 12 to 13 minutes until flaky.
Garnish with fresh orange zest and serve warm over soft pearl barley.
tips: Gentle sweet orange replaces harsh acidic citrus while letting thyme perfume the fish.
Flaky and effortless to eat.

recipes.title: French Country Thyme, Summer Savory, Dark Cherry & Chicken Braise
recipes.summary: Tender diced chicken simmered with diced celery stalk, generous fresh thyme, summer savory, halved dark cherries, black pepper, and olive oil.
steps: Soften finely diced celery stalk, fresh thyme, and summer savory in olive oil 4 minutes, then cook diced chicken with black pepper 5 minutes.
Add broth and halved dark cherries; cover and simmer gently 7 minutes until tender and glossy.
Serve warm with spoonable ruby herb sauce.
tips: Thyme and sweet dark cherries turn a simple chicken skillet into a cozy Sunday dinner.
Soft and moist throughout.

recipes.title: Coastal Thyme, Saffron, Fennel Seed & Celery Poached Cod Pot
recipes.summary: Flaky white cod gently poached atop saffron pearl barley with celery stalk, fresh thyme, crushed fennel seed, and extra-virgin olive oil.
steps: Soften finely diced celery stalk, fresh thyme, and crushed fennel seed in olive oil 4 minutes.
Stir in cooked pearl barley, vegetable broth, and saffron threads; nestle cod fillets on top and cover tightly.
Steam-poach gently 8 to 9 minutes until cod flakes effortlessly.
tips: One-pot Mediterranean fish and grain supper with zero dry edges.
Aromatic and ultra-tender.

recipes.title: Warm Thyme, Sage, Red Lentil & Butternut Stew with Walnut Oil
recipes.summary: Velvety stovetop stew simmering red lentils and small-diced butternut squash with generous thyme, fresh sage, black pepper, and cold-pressed walnut oil.
steps: Soften diced squash, fresh thyme, and minced sage in olive oil 4 minutes.
Add rinsed red lentils, broth, and black pepper; simmer gently 15 minutes until creamy and smooth.
Ladle into warm bowls and finish with cold-pressed walnut oil.
tips: Warm herbs turn creamy red lentils into deeply comforting autumn fare.
Easy to swallow and plant-rich.

recipes.title: Savory Thyme, Black Tea-Braised Turkey & Barley Skillet
recipes.summary: Rich homestyle ground turkey gently simmered with celery stalk, mild brewed black tea, generous thyme, cinnamon, black pepper, and sunflower oil over barley.
steps: Soften finely diced celery stalk and fresh thyme in sunflower oil 3 minutes, then cook finely crumbled turkey with cinnamon and black pepper 5 minutes.
Add mild black tea and chicken broth, simmering 7 minutes until savory and juicy.
Spoon over warm cooked pearl barley and serve.
tips: Mild black tea lends slow-braised richness to quick ground turkey.
Tender crumbles are effortless to chew.

recipes.title: Botanical Fresh Thyme, Blueberry, Banana & Flaxseed Oil Smoothie
recipes.summary: Velvety violet smoothie blending wild blueberries, frozen ripe banana, fresh thyme leaves, oat milk, and cold-pressed flaxseed oil.
steps: Blend oat milk, frozen blueberries, ripe banana, and fresh thyme leaves 45 seconds until completely silky.
Add cold-pressed flaxseed oil and pulse 3 seconds.
Pour chilled and serve immediately.
tips: Tiny fresh thyme leaves blend smoothly and give blueberries a subtle floral finish.
Naturally sweet and omega-3 rich.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Thyme, Sweet Orange, Cantaloupe & Olive Oil Smoothie
recipes.summary: Sunlit orange-peach blend uniting sweet orange, chilled cantaloupe, fresh thyme leaves, Greek yogurt, and fruity extra-virgin olive oil.
steps: Blend peeled sweet orange, chilled cantaloupe, Greek yogurt, and fresh thyme leaves until velvety.
Add fruity extra-virgin olive oil and pulse 2 seconds.
Serve cold right away.
tips: Mediterranean citrus, melon, and thyme make a refreshing sunny morning drink.
Silky and mild.

recipes.title: Orchard Thyme, Dark Cherry, Purple Grape & Walnut Oil Smoothie
recipes.summary: Deep ruby smoothie combining frozen dark cherries, purple grapes, fresh thyme leaves, soft chilled barley, and cold-pressed walnut oil.
steps: Blend oat milk, frozen dark cherries, purple grapes, chilled cooked barley, and fresh thyme leaves 50 seconds.
Add cold-pressed walnut oil and pulse 2 seconds.
Pour cold and enjoy right away.
tips: Whole-grain barley adds gentle creaminess to dark orchard fruits and thyme.
Zero added sweeteners.

recipes.title: Soothing Thyme, Raspberry, Lemon Balm & Ginger Yogurt Smoothie
recipes.summary: Bright herbal berry blend pairing frozen raspberries, calming lemon balm, fresh thyme leaves, grated ginger, yogurt, and sunflower oil.
steps: Blend cold water, Greek yogurt, frozen raspberries, fresh thyme, lemon balm, and grated ginger until smooth.
Add mild sunflower oil, pulse 2 seconds, and strain briefly if desired to remove raspberry seeds.
Serve chilled immediately.
tips: Soothing botanical garden flavors with bright berry tang.
Straining ensures velvet smoothness.

recipes.title: Warm-Spiced Thyme, Dark Chocolate, Banana & Cinnamon Smoothie
recipes.summary: Aromatic velvety cacao shake blending frozen banana, finely chopped 70% dark chocolate, cinnamon, a pinch of fresh thyme, and pumpkin seed oil.
steps: Blend oat milk, frozen banana, chopped dark chocolate, ground cinnamon, and fresh thyme leaves 45 seconds until silky.
Add roasted pumpkin seed oil and pulse 2 seconds.
Pour chilled and serve right away.
tips: A tiny hint of fresh thyme lifts rich dark chocolate unexpectedly cleanly.
Dairy-free and lush.

recipes.title: Soothing Thyme-Infused Orange, Fresh Ginger & Turmeric Tonic
recipes.summary: Traditional throat-soothing thyme tea chilled and blended with fresh orange juice, grated ginger, turmeric, and a tiny crack of black pepper.

ingredient_details.note: steeped in 1/2 cup hot water 4 minutes and chilled

steps: Steep fresh thyme sprigs in 1/2 cup hot water 4 minutes, strain cleanly, and chill.
Stir fresh orange juice, grated ginger, turmeric, and a tiny pinch of black pepper into the chilled thyme infusion.
Pass smoothly through a fine-mesh sieve and pour cold.
tips: Thyme infusion has a long traditional culinary history paired with citrus and ginger.
Crisp, smooth, and gentle.

recipes.title: Ruby Thyme, Red Grape, Blueberry & Spearmint Botanical Press
recipes.summary: Deep purple orchard juice combining chilled thyme tea, pressed sweet red grapes, fresh blueberries, and cooling spearmint.

ingredient_details.note: steeped in 1/2 cup hot water 4 minutes and chilled

steps: Steep thyme in 1/2 cup hot water 4 minutes, strain, and chill.
Blend chilled thyme infusion, red grapes, blueberries, and spearmint leaves 30 seconds.
Strain cleanly through a fine-mesh sieve and serve cold.
tips: Rich in dark berry anthocyanins and gentle garden thyme perfume.
Naturally sweet with zero syrup.

recipes.title: Garden Thyme, Celery Stalk, Cantaloupe & Sweet Basil Press
recipes.summary: Refreshing golden-green press uniting chilled thyme tea, ripe cantaloupe, celery stalk, and fresh sweet basil leaves.

ingredient_details.note: steeped in 1/2 cup hot water 4 minutes and chilled

steps: Steep thyme in 1/2 cup hot water 4 minutes, strain, and chill.
Blend chilled thyme tea, cantaloupe cubes, chopped celery stalk, and sweet basil leaves 35 seconds.
Press smoothly through a fine strainer and serve chilled.
tips: Ripe melon softens savory garden herbs into a crisp hydrating sipper.
Completely pulp-free.

recipes.title: Chilled Thyme, Black Tea, Dark Cherry & Lemon Balm Cooler
recipes.summary: Smooth ruby iced tea steeping mild black tea with fresh thyme, then blending with strained sweet dark cherries and calming lemon balm.

ingredient_details.note: steeped with black tea 3 minutes and strained

steps: Steep mild black tea with fresh thyme sprigs 3 minutes, strain cleanly, and chill.
Blend pitted dark cherries, orange juice, fresh lemon balm, and 1/2 cup chilled thyme tea 30 seconds, then strain cleanly.
Stir back into remaining chilled tea and pour cold.
tips: Use decaf black tea for a calming evening herbal tea press.
Bright and soothing.

recipes.title: Velvet Thyme, Barley Water, Raspberry & Fresh Shiso Press
recipes.summary: Silky ruby press pairing chilled barley water, steeped thyme tea, strained fresh raspberries, and aromatic shiso leaves.

ingredient_details.note: steeped in 1/3 cup hot water 4 minutes and chilled

steps: Steep fresh thyme in 1/3 cup hot water 4 minutes, strain, and chill.
Blend raspberries, orange juice, shiso leaves, and chilled thyme tea 30 seconds, then strain thoroughly to catch seeds.
Stir smoothly into chilled barley water and serve immediately.
tips: Velvety barley water carries bright berries and garden herbs smoothly.
Zero seeds and gentle on the throat.
